resources.string: Send and receive files directly between devices.
Local network access lets Nuvyro find and be found by devices on the same Wi-Fi network.
App settings could not be opened. Please try again.
Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network. Internet access is not required.
Use the same Wi-Fi network, or scan a hotspot QR from the receiving device.
Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network. No internet connection is needed.
Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi, or connect through a temporary hotspot.
Use shared Wi-Fi or share a hotspot QR with the sender.
Let the sender scan your Wi-Fi QR to connect directly. Android creates the network name and password. This may replace your current Wi-Fi connection.
Automatic hotspot creation needs Android 8 or later and device support. Connect both devices to a shared Wi-Fi network instead.
Android needs nearby Wi-Fi access to create a hotspot. On older devices, this requires the location permission.
This Android version requires Location to be enabled for a local hotspot. Nuvyro does not use it to determine your position.
You can return to Receive while the hotspot starts.
Your profile is available now. Let the sender scan the QR, then open their receiver radar. Returning to Receive keeps your hotspot on.
On the sending device, scan with the camera or the QR scanner in Wi-Fi settings. Confirm the connection, then return to Nuvyro.
The QR code could not be created. Use the network name and password below to connect.
Keep Nuvyro open while connecting. Returning to Receive keeps the hotspot on. It stops if you stop receiving, tap Stop hotspot, leave the app, or rotate the screen.
The hotspot could not start or was stopped by Android. Close any existing hotspot and try again, or use a shared Wi-Fi network.
Start a new hotspot to reconnect the sender, or use shared Wi-Fi.

1. Ask the receiver to create a hotspot from Receive → Connect the devices.

2. Scan their Wi-Fi QR with your camera or Wi-Fi settings, then confirm the connection. You can also enter the network name and password.

3. Return to Nuvyro. Discovery resumes automatically; tap Back to radar to view receivers.
If Android says the hotspot has no internet, choose to stay connected. The hotspot is only used to connect the devices.
Starting discovery on your Wi-Fi network.
Keep this screen open. Your name and photo will appear to Nuvyro users on the same Wi-Fi network.
Your hotspot is on. The sender can find your profile after joining. Keep Nuvyro in the foreground; open the QR whenever they need to connect.
Check your Wi-Fi connection and try again.
Your pairing QR will appear when this device is ready.
Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network, then try again.

Ask the other person to keep Receive open on the same Wi-Fi network or their Nuvyro hotspot. Tap their profile when it appears.

A little setup, then you are ready to share.
Choose where received files will go and review a few optional settings. Camera and nearby device access will be requested when you use those features.
Add a name and photo for nearby sharing. You can skip this and edit your profile from the top right of Home. Until then, your device name will be used.
Allow notifications for transfer progress and incoming file requests when sharing is available.
Notifications are optional. You can continue without them.
Notifications are off. You can enable them in system settings or skip this step.
Android manages background activity. Reviewing battery settings can help with long transfers when sharing is available.
Battery optimization is already disabled for Nuvyro.
This step is optional. In battery optimization settings, find Nuvyro to review its limits. Device-specific restrictions may still apply.
Choose a folder for received files. Nuvyro only needs access to the folder you select.
You can create a Nuvyro folder inside Documents. Android may not allow selecting storage roots or the Downloads folder itself.
Setup could not be saved. Please try again.
This folder could not be saved or cannot receive files. Please choose a writable folder.
